title: Priority Negotiator: Dynamic Acceptance & Runway for Strategic Customer Requests
creator: Sofia Chen
description: Problem: Strategic customers escalate feature requests and SLA commitments informally, creating unpredictable roadmap churn and misaligned expectations across Sales, CS, and Eng. Goal: Create a lightweight, enforceable acceptance and commitment runway system that (1) triages escalations for top accounts, (2) offers clear commitment bands (Runway A/B/C) tied to measurable SLAs, and (3) embeds a negotiation flow so PMs can offer time-boxed commitments without derailing planned work. Approach: Build an intake form + scoring engine, decision playbook for acceptance thresholds, an approval path for executive sponsors, and a visible runway calculator in the Console so sales/CS can see commitment windows and fallback options.
acceptance_criteria: Intake form v1 available to CS/Sales with mandatory fields for business impact, legal constraints, and target date
Scoring engine computes Priority Score (0-100) from account gravity, revenue at risk, regulatory urgency, estimated effort, and release coupling
Three commitment bands defined: Runway A (30d), Runway B (60d), Runway C (90d) with clear eligibility rules
Approval workflow implemented: PM + Eng lead for Runway A/B, Exec sponsor sign-off required for Runway C
Console view shows active commitments, remaining runway days, and fallback policy (compatible model variant or mitigation plan)
Pilot with 5 top accounts runs for one cycle and collects resolution time, NPS from CS, and roadmap slippage metric

rollout_plan: Week 1: Finalize scoring weights and intake form fields; legal review for Runway C language
Week 2: Implement HubSpot intake + Confluence mirror; build Console Commitment card mock in Figma; Eng begins autoscale integration work
Week 3: Internal trial with Sales/CS for two top accounts; collect feedback and refine acceptance thresholds
Week 4: Pilot launch with 5 nominated accounts; measure metrics and prepare go/no-go for broader rollout
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Legal/Contracts pushback on firm deadlines -> Mitigation: Offer time-boxed 'soft commitments' with defined fallback policies; require Contracts approval for Runway C.
Risk: Eng capacity constraints make commitments unfulfillable -> Mitigation: Tie commitments to capacity reservations (ENG-38921) and include compatible-model fallback paths.
Risk: Sales/CS misuse system to escalate lower-priority asks -> Mitigation: Enforce scoring thresholds and require executive sponsor for overrides; audit trail retained in Console.
